entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, my agent ID is 301. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Isaac, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse. I want a return label sent to my email immediately. This is ridiculous.
I can certainly look into starting a return for you. To pull up your order, could I please get your name and email address?
The name is Mark Peterson. Look, I don't want a big song and dance. I want to return it, simple as that. Are you going to help me or not?

Yes, of course, Mr. Peterson. I'm pulling up your account now. Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered 22 days ago. So I can document the reason correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

There is no issue! I just **changed my mind**. It was a stupid **impulse buy** and I **don't use it**. I want my money back. I'm not going to argue about it. Either you process this refund or I'm speaking to a manager and leaving a one-star review on every website I can find.
That won't be necessary, sir, I'm happy to help. Let me just take a quick look at the official return policy for you. Please hold for one moment.

Thank you for your patience. Okay, I've checked our internal policy guide. It states that all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since you're only on day 22, you are well within that timeframe.
Good. So you're sending the label then?
Yes, absolutely. I've just approved the return in our system. I'm sending the pre-paid return label to the email address on file right now. You should see it arrive in the next few minutes.
Okay. And how long does the refund take?
Once our warehouse receives the item, please allow 3-5 business days for the funds to be credited back to your original form of payment.
Great. Was there anything else I could assist you with today, Mr. Peterson?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
